I farm here in the North West, and this small maize plot of mine is close to the compound so I can watch it well. The rains will start soon and I must plan now before the market prices for fertilizer go up again. I own this land, so I am willing to put some money into it, but I have a bigger farm of almost 2.5 hectares to manage also, so I cannot spend everything here.

For this maize plot, I will buy a little NPK 15-15-15 at planting and top-dress with urea when the maize is knee-high — this is what the agro-dealer in town sells and what my neighbours use. I will also carry manure from my goats and chickens to this plot because it is close to the house. I will try to get improved maize seed from the agro-dealer if the price is reasonable; otherwise I will use grain I saved from last season. I cannot irrigate — there is no fadama on this plot, only the rains. My wife and older children will help me weed, but I may need to hire a few young men for the first weeding because the weeds come fast after the rains.
